question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word In the given sentence.

He just needs to __calm down__ a wee bit.
solution:
The correct answer is Option no. (2) **'agitate'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Antonym of **"calm down"** is **"agitate."** - "Agitate" means to make someone feel anxious or troubled.
 
• The word** 'Calm down'** means become quiet or calm, especially after a state of agitation.
